statement_seal.definition: noncomputable def singleBlockPrecision {n : ℕ} (κ : ℝ) (O : Matrix.orthogonalGroup (Fin n) ℝ) : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ := ((κ + 1) / 2) • (1 : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) - ((κ - 1) / 4) • ((O : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) + (O : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ).transpose)
statement_seal.signature: theorem singleBlockPrecision_regular {n : ℕ} (_hn : 3 ≤ n) {κ : ℝ} (hκ : 4 ≤ κ) (O : Matrix.orthogonalGroup (Fin n) ℝ) : (singleBlockPrecision κ O).IsHermitian ∧ ∀ v : Fin n → ℝ, v ⬝ᵥ v ≤ v ⬝ᵥ (singleBlockPrecision κ O *ᵥ v) ∧ v ⬝ᵥ (singleBlockPrecision κ O *ᵥ v) ≤ κ * (v ⬝ᵥ v)
statement_seal.quantifier_audit: Universally quantified n, kappa and O, then Hermitianity and simultaneous two-sided bounds for every real coordinate vector v. No chosen v, existential vector, probabilistic event, determinant-sign restriction, or uniform-in-O probability statement replaces the source universal quantifiers.
statement_seal.endpoint_audit: Both inequalities are non-strict. The source's endpoints kappa = 4 and n = 3 are retained. No positivity of individual coordinates or nonzero-v restriction is added. v = 0 is included.

definition_audit.formula_match: The source coefficient (kappa+1)/2 multiplies the identity matrix, and (kappa-1)/4 multiplies O + transpose O. Every sign, coefficient and transpose agrees with equation (4). Matrix scalar multiplication is entrywise real scalar multiplication. No inverse, normalization, fallback branch or chosen witness is introduced.
definition_audit.whole_public_carrier: The literal algebraic formula is retained for every real kappa and every orthogonal matrix on every Fin n. The definition has no off-source default. The regularity theorem intentionally retains the narrower source standing range.
definition_audit.noncomputable_note: noncomputable addresses executable real-division requirements; it does not change the mathematical body or add a logical hypothesis.

matrix_semantics.audit: Abbreviation of unitaryGroup under the trivial star on a commutative ring. mem_orthogonalGroup_iff and mem_orthogonalGroup_iff' explicitly characterize O O^T = I and O^T O = I. For real entries this is the source orthogonal group.
A.conjTranspose = A. Real star is trivial, and isHermitian_iff_isSymm identifies this with A^T = A. The apparent Hermitian terminology adds no complex setting or assumption.

dotProduct v w = sum_i v_i*w_i. Thus v dot v = sum_i v_i^2 is the squared Euclidean 2-norm in the source. It is not being identified with the default Pi norm on Fin n -> R, which is generally a supremum norm. The sealed signature contains no use of that Pi norm.
The ith coordinate is sum_j A_ij*v_j. Consequently v dot (A *v v) is exactly v^T A v.

definition_audit.loewner_order_audit: For a real symmetric matrix, the source I <= A <= kappa I in positive-semidefinite order is equivalent to the two non-strict quadratic-form inequalities for every vector. The signature states symmetry and these inequalities explicitly; it does not accidentally use entrywise Matrix order. No spectral theorem assumption is needed as a public binder.
definition_audit.hidden_analysis_contracts: No measures, probabilities, integrals, conditional representatives, differentiability, boundary decay or analytic regularity enter this finite-dimensional literal matrix statement.
